verdict.rationale: Cloudflare says customers can see registration, transfer, and renewal prices upfront with no hidden fees, and that renewals happen only at the registry's list price at cost with no markup, which addresses the teaser-then-spike concern. Community posts cite concrete per-TLD prices (.io, .space). Those posts complain that some TLDs cost more than at rival registrars, which concerns price level rather than transparency, so it does not create a dispute. However, the evidence never shows a published, browsable full price list broken out per TLD with separate registration, renewal, and transfer columns. missing for 10: evidence of a published full per-TLD price list with registration, renewal, and transfer listed separately; independent hands-on confirmation that first-year and renewal prices match.

support.subject: As a founder, the full price list is published — registration, renewal, and transfer priced separately per TLD, with no teaser first-year price hiding a renewal spike

citations.quote: See registration, transfer, and renewal prices upfront, with no hidden fees or required add-ons.
Unlike other registrars, your domain will only renew at the list price set by the registry.
You only pay what is charged by registries and ICANN.
Charging the exact same price as the registry wholesale price.
